name: Icon toolbar with tooltips, and a status bar with counts, camera and fps
body:
# Toolbar and status bar

Toolbar buttons become icons (`<icon>` from Penumbra's StandardIconBackend, with the new editor glyphs) with a text
tooltip on hover (needs `onHoverEnd`, see the penumbra and chaos cards). The status bar shows the message, entity and
selection counts, the camera's target and distance, the active tool and snap state, and the frame rate.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. IconButton.chaos with <icon> glyphs and a debounced tooltip portal (clamped to the window); StatusBar.chaos shows message, counts, tool, space, snap, camera, fps and draws, refreshed twice a second.
